core.title: Ornate 1 Inch Ring Pull, RK International CF-598

text.description_html:
RK International CF-598, Fancy Ring Pull

The Ornate 1 Inch Ring Pull is great for those who want to add a little victorian design to their decor. The backplate of this finger cabinet pull is interesting and intricate. It will add just the right amount of drama to any small drawer or door. The ring itself has a 1 inch diameter, so little and big hands alike will find it comfortable to use. It is easy to install with the screws that come packaged with it. Available in 5 finishes including the ever popular satin nickel and the beautiful antique english (pictured right).

Specifications and Features of the RK International CF-598 1" Ring with Ornate Plate:

  • Material: Brass
  • Plate Length: 3-1/4"
  • Plate Width: 1-1/16"
  • Ring Diameter: 1"
  • Projection: 3/4"
  • Screws: #6 x 3/4" wood screws.
  • Packaged with all necessary installation hardware.

Sold Individually
